Parse Conditions Disabled¶

Specification: Spec with raw link containing brackets SPEC_RAW_001
raw links outgoing: REQ_001[status=="open"]

The raw_links link type has parse_conditions: False, so the brackets are treated as literal ID text, not as a condition.
